### Verified targeted Android history checkpoint; issue remains open

[Actual immutable run40453976628](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40453976628) at`be32a7d61bdf025cf1a115aea9ac07c8062f3623` passes **25/25 fresh emulator executions**, zero failures/errors/skips, one XML;`:calf-webview:connectedAndroidDeviceTest` exits0/72.03s. The owned API35/x86_64 emulator remains SELinux **Enforcing** and shuts down cleanly.

Exactly **one device-specific integration method plus24 inherited common methods** ran. The real HTTPS fixture is served once by the supplied library-owned client; real touch/user activation creates native history, native back restores both list/capabilities and actual DOM#first, and navigator-only replacement reads both current flags without recreating/disposing the WebView. This is not25 independent native scenarios or separate state/callback/teardown coverage.

[Independent Git/ZIP/XML review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/cebdc8f206a5e34b39e1cb8053b380ba509707c2/docs/development/evidence/github-actions/40453976628/lead-independent-review.json) and [additive scope correction](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/cebdc8f206a5e34b39e1cb8053b380ba509707c2/docs/development/evidence/github-actions/40453976628/additive-scope-correction.json) preserve the original review's incorrect second-device-method claim. Earlier failed runs remain unchanged.

Disposition advances only to **partially verified**, not closed. Required stateA/stateB and latest-callback substitution, rapid queued JavaFX replacement, iOS/other-target/native-provider/minimum-device coverage, packaged consumers and ABI remain outstanding. All original acceptance requirements and the issue body are retained. No publishing/release gate is cleared.
